claim.claim-text: 1. A solid phase dispersion formulation, comprising Edaravone or its pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof as an active ingredient, and comprising a polyvinyl caprolactam-polyvinyl acetate-polyethylene glycol graft copolymer and optionally TPGS 1000.
2. The solid phase dispersion formulation of claim 1 wherein the ratio of drug to polymer is 1:1, 1:3, 1:5, 1:7, 1:8, 1:10, 1:13, or 1:16.
3. The solid phase dispersion formulation of claim 2, wherein the ratio is 1:5.

4. A method of preparing the solid phase dispersion formulation of claim 1, comprising a step of: dispersing Edaravone or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof as an active ingredient in a polyvinyl caprolactam-polyvinyl acetate-polyethylene glycol graft copolymer and, optionally, TPGS 1000, particularly, further comprising a step selected from: melting ice bath agitation, thin film cooling, liquid nitrogen, spray congealing, hot-melt extrusion, Meltrex<™>, melt agglomeration or solvent evaporation (oven drying, vacuum drying, rotary evaporation, heating on hot plate, spray drying, freeze drying, supercritical anti-solvent, co-precipitation, electrostatic spinning, spray freeze drying, ultra-rapid freezing, fluid-bed coating) and solvent melting.
5. The solid phase dispersion formulation of any of claims 1-3, wherein dose of Edaravone is 0.001-1000 mg/unit, or 0.1-100 mg/unit, or 10-20 mg/unit in a solid formulation.

6. The solid phase dispersion formulation of any of claims 1-3, formulated as a solid dosage form selected from a tablet, a capsule, powders or strips (strip), by oral, parenteral, inhalation, topical or transdermal, intranasal, ocular, ear, rectal, vaginal route, or formulated as a semi-solid dosage form selected from ointment, cream, gel, paste, by topical or transdermal route, for a topical or systemic administration purpose.

7. The solid phase dispersion formulation of any of claims 1-3 for use in the treatment of an oxidative stress-related disease, particularly, the oxidative stress-related disease is selected from Alzheimer's disease, ALS, Parkinson's disease, ischemic heart disease, cerebral infarction/stroke, COPD, HIV/AIDS and diabetes.
